item: the four 409 refusals of a download start now write a WARNING with the reason (R386)
summary: #1671 mapped a refused start to 409 but wrote nothing, so the refusal reached only the caller. The wiki dump start, the dump index build, the OSM start and the OSM resume each log through log_failure at WARNING (scrubbed; the exception's own line says whether a build was already running or the worker thread could not start). Three new tests prove each line is written; each of the four lines removed fails one.
